evidence.log_note: запись RUNTIME — запись ПРОГОНА: каждая строка sql[] — ЦЕЛЫЙ оператор журнала сервера PG18 (log_statement=all, log_error_verbosity=verbose) окна прогона test:core («statement: <sql>⏎» либо «execute <unnamed>: <sql>⏎»), каждая ошибка errors[] — строка «ERROR:  <sqlstate>: <message>» того же окна целиком (допустим лишь хвост позиции курсора « at character <N>»); для записей дерева — окно свежего прогона того же закоммиченного test:core (воспроизводимость). Конформный текст sql — стабильный между прогонами (параметры $N, без случайных имён; безымянные prepared statements), message — e.message ошибки PG без правок

mutations.damage_note: первые 4 — флаги каталога (контракт 121, инв. 3); остальные — свойство сломано при ЦЕЛЫХ флагах (tgenabled=O, relforcerowsecurity, NOBYPASSRLS): обход Rev121 bypass.sql и Adv121 (тело guard_immutable — пропуск), вердикты contracts-121-impl-v1; набор test:core обязан краснеть на каждой, иначе testy-pustye. Порядок: сброс БД → контроль (rc 0) → СНОВА сброс БД → DAMAGE → прогон (красен) → revert: повреждённый прогон в тех же условиях, что контроль (БД-побочка контроля не краснит его без мутации). SQL однострочный (без TAB/LF/обратной косой: @tsv)

damage.name: immutable_body
damage.sql: CREATE SCHEMA yadro121_stash; CREATE TABLE yadro121_stash.def AS SELECT pg_get_functiondef('app.guard_immutable()'::regprocedure) AS def; CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app.guard_immutable() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path = pg_catalog AS $f$ BEGIN IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN RETURN OLD; END IF; RETURN NEW; END $f$;
damage.revert: DO $r$ BEGIN EXECUTE (SELECT def FROM yadro121_stash.def); END $r$; DROP SCHEMA yadro121_stash CASCADE;

damage.revert: DO $r$ BEGIN EXECUTE (SELECT def FROM yadro121_stash.def); END $r$; DROP SCHEMA yadro121_stash CASCADE;

damage.name: rls_open
damage.sql: DO $d$ DECLARE t record; BEGIN FOR t IN SELECT n.nspname, c.relname FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('app', 'control') AND c.relkind IN ('r', 'p') AND c.relrowsecurity LOOP EXECUTE format('CREATE POLICY yadro121_open ON %I.%I FOR ALL TO PUBLIC USING (true) WITH CHECK (true)', t.nspname, t.relname); END LOOP; END $d$;
damage.revert: DO $d$ DECLARE t record; BEGIN FOR t IN SELECT n.nspname, c.relname FROM pg_policy p JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = p.polrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE p.polname = 'yadro121_open' LOOP EXECUTE format('DROP POLICY yadro121_open ON %I.%I', t.nspname, t.relname); END LOOP; END $d$;

damage.name: public_grant
damage.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA app, control TO PUBLIC; GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA app, control TO PUBLIC; GRANT EXECUTE ON ALL FUNCTIONS IN SCHEMA app, control TO PUBLIC;
damage.revert: REVOKE SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA app, control FROM PUBLIC; REVOKE USAGE ON SCHEMA app, control FROM PUBLIC;

damage.name: audit_redaction
damage.sql: CREATE SCHEMA yadro121_stash; CREATE TABLE yadro121_stash.def AS SELECT pg_get_functiondef('control.audit_runtime_admin_change()'::regprocedure) AS def; CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION control.audit_runtime_admin_change() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog AS $f$ DECLARE actor uuid; command_id text; BEGIN actor := app.current_principal_id(); command_id := nullif(current_setting('brokeros.admin_command_id', true), ''); IF actor IS NULL OR command_id IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '42501', MESSAGE = 'ADMIN_AUDIT_CONTEXT_REQUIRED'; END IF; INSERT INTO control.runtime_admin_audit(table_name, row_key, action, actor_principal_id, actor_database_role, admin_command_id, before_metadata, after_metadata) VALUES (TG_TABLE_NAME, NEW.id::text, TG_OP, actor, session_user, command_id, CASE WHEN TG_OP = 'UPDATE' THEN to_jsonb(OLD) END, to_jsonb(NEW)); RETURN NEW; END $f$;
damage.revert: DO $r$ BEGIN EXECUTE (SELECT def FROM yadro121_stash.def); END $r$; DROP SCHEMA yadro121_stash CASCADE;

damage.name: audit_erase
damage.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA control TO PUBLIC; GRANT SELECT, UPDATE, DELETE ON control.runtime_admin_audit TO PUBLIC; CREATE POLICY yadro121_erase ON control.runtime_admin_audit FOR ALL TO PUBLIC USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);
